description: This Java source file defines an Android app widget called 'BuildWidget' that displays build information such as build ID, date, and fingerprint. It includes an inner service 'UpdateService' responsible for updating the widget's views. The widget also sets up a click action to open device info settings.

classes.name: BuildWidget
classes.description: An AppWidgetProvider that updates the widget and spawns a background service to handle updates.

classes.name: BuildWidget.UpdateService
classes.description: A background Service responsible for updating the widget's RemoteViews with build info and handling the widget update process.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Called when the widget needs to be updated; starts the UpdateService to perform the update.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles the Service start event; builds the widget update and pushes it to the home screen.

methods.name: buildUpdate
methods.description: Constructs and returns a RemoteViews object containing build information and a click action.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as the service does not support binding.
